title: Workforce-group reference
description: access/identity-center/groups/<group-key>.yml - a reference to an externally managed workforce group, never created by this repository (configuration contract; T05 #7 d2; ADR-0007). The filename stem must equal key exactly (KEY-FILENAME, enforced by the validator).

key.description: Stable repository identity; equals the filename stem exactly (T05 #7 d1/d2).

identity_store_name.description: Exact Identity Store DisplayName of the externally managed group; compared by Unicode code-point sequence with no normalization (T05 #7 d2/d5).
identity_store_name.$comment: The no-leading/trailing-Unicode-whitespace and no-control-character rules (KEY-IDSTORE-NAME) are enforced by the T14 #19 validator; JSON Schema regex cannot express the exact Unicode classes.

source.description: Optional informational provenance only - never lookup, authorization, or reconciliation input (T05 #7 d2).
